title: Keyword market data: Columbus, MN
description: Top Columbus, MN service keywords by estimated monthly searches, CPC and value, with sponsored-spot starting bids.
note: Values: searches/mo = US monthly searches (national) or registry estimate for the metro/state (local); CPC = keyword top-of-page low bid where published, else industry benchmark median; value = searches x CPC (search value index, not revenue); Google Ads equiv = searches x industry CTR x CPC. '(est)' marks registry estimates. Volume and value rankings include only keywords whose US volume is published; keywords with estimated volume are on their keyword pages. Methods and sources: https://registry-edge.dingalinged.workers.dev/api/market/index.json
